decisions: Emit every selected frame slot at function entry, local numbering per actual concrete function IR.

For direct fixed Int literal bindings, selected allocation means frame alias plus lifetime.start of allocation.size; no selection means independent heap backing, including >4096-byte and async empty-frame cases.
Use the same heap/stack classification in fixed return promotion and owner cleanup; never free a selected frame slot.
Keep existing non-binding and non-Int paths outside this first focused consumer unit.
Declare LLVM lifetime intrinsics once in the runtime preamble.
implementationScope: Private consumer17278 candidates. Slot aliases wired through hoisted allocas; lifetime starts wired through function, entry and region literal emission. Shared required allocation boundary emits an explicit terminating diagnostic on invalid context/lookup; no recovery fallback. Unit source-owned lifetime ends and mutable headers are pending.
